transcript.text: I need to flag a critical compliance issue. I received a policy amendment in this morning's compliance circular that has not yet been circulated to the investment committee. The amendment caps our company's commitment to this fund strategy at exactly $5,000,000 — which means the proposed $6,000,000 commitment would exceed the limit by $1,000,000. Additionally, the amendment requires qualified-purchaser certification before signing, and quarterly look-through reporting. All three requirements would need to be satisfied before we can proceed.

transcript.text: I have an important execution requirement to flag. I received the fund administrator's confirmation today that the first capital call will be exactly $1,200,000 within 5 business days after signing, and treasury can ring-fence that amount in cash. Critically, the confirmation states a fixed dollar figure — it does not scale proportionally if the commitment amount is reduced. So even if we reduce the commitment to $5,000,000 to comply with the cap Jonas just mentioned, the first capital call would still be $1,200,000. This confirmation has not yet been added to the committee packet, so I want to make sure everyone has this information before we proceed.
